invariants.rationale: The first check in the method throws if 'name' is null, ensuring that by METHOD_EXIT, 'name' is non-null.
The method throws immediately if 'type' is null, guaranteeing that 'type' is non-null at any normal exit.
A GdxRuntimeException is thrown if no resource is found, and all code paths return a casted, non-null reference.
Result is always either a type-specific resource or a resource of the given type, thus it should be an instance of 'type'.
Result is either exactly an instance of 'type' or one of its subclasses/implementations, due to explicit casting and resource fetching logic.
